name: Cursor
description: Cursor is an AI-assisted code editor. Its pricing page lists Free, Plus, Premium, Super and Ultra individual plans plus Teams and Enterprise.
features: AI usage pool shared across Cursor products
Cloud agents and automations (Premium and above)
Code hosting and AI code reviews (Premium and above)
Third-party models billed at API list price
useCases: Writing and editing code with AI help
limitations: Third-party model usage is billed separately from the plan price
The page's plan cards also mention Grok products; we could not confirm from the page how the bundle is structured

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Described as an introductory plan. The page says Plus includes Grok models only.

plans.name: Premium
highlights: Code hosting and AI code reviews
Third-party models at API list price
plans.note: The page FAQ recommends Premium for new AI users. Premium and above include usage of Grok models; third-party models are billed at API list price.

plans.name: Super
highlights: Priority model access at peak times

plans.name: Ultra
highlights: Earliest access to all products and models

plans.name: Teams
plans.note: '$30+' per user; listed in the comparison table only

free.details: Limited AI usage, limited agent requests and limited chat requests (card text).

pricing.regional: Prices shown on the pricing page exclude taxes and third-party model usage is billed separately. For a Pakistan visitor, the owner's screenshots of the subscription modal show rupee prices: monthly Plus PKR 2,200 (introductory PKR 1,650 for six months), Premium PKR 8,300 (PKR 4,150 for the first month), Super PKR 28,000 (PKR 14,000 first month) and Ultra PKR 56,000 (PKR 28,000 first month); on annual billing Plus PKR 22,000, Premium PKR 83,000, Super PKR 280,000 and Ultra PKR 560,000 per year. Those rupee amounts are in proportion to the USD prices above.
notes: Allowances refresh weekly. Third-party model usage is billed separately at API list price.

verification.notes: Product active (AI coding agent). Re-read on 2 Nov 2026 in the built-in browser, both the Individual and Teams tabs: Free $0, Plus $8, Premium $30, Super $100 and Ultra $200 per month, and Teams $30 per month, match the stored prices; Enterprise is contact-sales. Prices exclude taxes, and third-party model usage is billed separately. It stays partial because the page text is unusual (it mixes in social-network features and a usage pool shared with Grok), Plus is limited to Grok models, the Teams price does not say whether it is per seat, and the usage allowances are stated only as multiples of Plus. Needs manual review.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser (Individual and Teams tabs read), plus screenshots of the subscription modal supplied by the site owner

profile.headline: A coding agent for building software

capabilities.title: Hand off a task and review the result
capabilities.text: Agents work on their own computers to build, test and demo a feature end to end, then show you the finished work.

capabilities.title: Run many agents at once
capabilities.text: Teams can launch agents that work in parallel on tasks that take hours or days.

capabilities.title: Work where your team already works
capabilities.text: Use Cursor Desktop, the Cursor CLI, the Slack integration, or have it review GitHub pull requests.

capabilities.title: Pick the model for the job
capabilities.text: Choose from models by OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI and Cursor itself, as the site lists them.

featureCards.name: Autonomous agents
featureCards.text: Agents that build, test and demonstrate their own work instead of only suggesting code.

featureCards.name: Parallel agents
featureCards.text: Several agents on separate tasks at the same time, for larger pieces of work.

featureCards.name: CLI
featureCards.text: Install the command-line version with a single curl command.

featureCards.name: Slack and GitHub
featureCards.text: Start work from Slack and get help reviewing pull requests.

featureCards.name: Model choice
featureCards.text: Models from several providers are available in one place.

featureCards.name: Enterprise security
featureCards.text: The site lists SOC 2, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications for business customers.

audienceDetail.text: The main audience: people who write and ship code every day.
Teams that want to hand tasks to agents and review the output together.
The site offers demos and contact with sales for large organisations.
The site mentions Students as a group, without describing the offer in detail.

scenarios.title: Build a landing page or dashboard
scenarios.text: Start from documents or research data and have an agent produce an interactive page.

scenarios.title: Add a feature to an existing tool
scenarios.text: Implement an algorithm in a specialist tool and fix a parser, as shown in the site's examples.

scenarios.title: Clear small team requests
scenarios.text: Link changelog entries, add rate limits or fix a sign-in redirect.

gettingStarted.text: The site's download button lists macOS.
Use Get started to log in or create an account at the dashboard.
The CLI installs with: curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
Request a demo or contact sales.
